That's exactly the behavior I want. I clicked the checkmark on the JavaScript Guide, it dropped out of the Read later pile, the sidebar count cleared, and I got a nice "You're all caught up" message. And importantly, marking it read only took it off the later list — the bookmark itself is still safe in All bookmarks, so I haven't lost anything, I've just cleared it off my to-read stack. That's just how I'd want it to work.

I'm happy with the read-later flow. What's next?
